summary: The candidate is correct and complete. The lattice-polygon edge sequence gives a centrally symmetric strictly convex same-parity vertex set with nonzero antipodal pairs; the orthogonal-invariance and dilation argument produces the required ball whose half-mass metronoid is the Euclidean unit ball; and the convex-hull construction is full-dimensional with the stated exact endpoint fibers. The midpoint metronoid witnesses, matching legality, primal-dual equality, unique and exposed optimizer, saturated edge and endpoint loads, pairwise-disjoint target balls, and exact retainable mass all follow with the claimed normalizations. Both residual-rank bounds are valid, the centroid-selector estimate is strictly below 96t, the frame score is exactly 2t, and k >= 402 gives the strict CCE failure. The proof also correctly limits the example to an arbitrary legal matching and does not infer canonical dyadic provenance, HSF failure, or a conclusion about the weak Oertel conjecture.
